name: PropertySheet
description: A schema-bound property group whose values and edit policy are supplied by the host.

binding.description: Approved host binding address. This is a schema/read-model address, never a resolved value.

fields.description: Ordered host field keys to request from the binding.

validation: binding must be allowlisted and resolved by the host
fields must contain only keys exposed by the host schema projection
values, editability, visibility, validation, and mutation action ids never appear in RelayMark source
removing this block changes composition only and cannot delete bound domain data

projections.plain_text: title and field labels supplied by the host
